preferences.title: Preferences
preferences.description: Your own timezone, language, theme and where the dashboard opens. These follow your account to every browser.
preferences.avatarHint: Initials and a color derived from your account. Uploads are not supported.
preferences.timezoneHint: Dates across the dashboard are shown in this zone.
preferences.gravatarHint: Off by default. When on, your browser asks Gravatar for a picture using a hash of your email address, which tells Gravatar you use this dashboard.

activity.title: My activity
activity.description: What your own account did: sign-ins, token use, session changes and passkey or two-factor changes. Only your own activity is listed.
activity.emptyDescription: Sign-ins and account changes show up here as they happen.
activity.emptyFilteredDescription: Nothing in this category has been recorded for your account yet.

export.title: Export my data
export.description: Download a zip of your own profile, preferences, sessions, tokens (never their secrets), linked providers, team roles and activity.
export.expires: The file is kept for 15 minutes, then removed from the server.
export.failed: The export could not be built.
export.startFailed: The export could not be started.
export.noSecrets: Contains no passwords, token secrets or recovery codes.

email.title: Email address
email.description: Change the address you sign in with. A confirmation link goes to the new address first.
email.codeHint: This account uses two-factor authentication: enter the code from your authenticator app too.
email.sent: If the address can be used, a confirmation link is on its way. Open it while signed in here. It expires in an hour.
email.invalid: The password or code is not correct.
email.locked: Too many attempts. Try again in a few minutes.
email.notConfigured: This server cannot send email yet, so an address change cannot be verified.
email.confirmFailed: This confirmation link is invalid, expired or already used. Request a new one.
email.emailTaken: That address now belongs to another account.
email.passwordRequired: Accounts without a password cannot change their address here. Set a password first.
email.statusFailed: Whether email can be sent could not be checked.

unlink.title: Unlink {{provider}}?
unlink.description: You will no longer be able to sign in with {{provider}}. Your other sign-in methods are not affected.
unlink.lastMethodTitle: This is your only way to sign in
unlink.lastMethodDescription: Set a password or add a passkey first, then unlink {{provider}}.

danger.title: Danger zone
danger.description: Permanently delete your own account. This cannot be undone.
danger.checkFailed: We could not check whether your account can be deleted.
danger.blockedTitle: Your account cannot be deleted yet
danger.blockedIntro: Resolve each item below, then come back.

blockers.last_user: You are the only user on this server.
blockers.last_root: You are the last administrator. Another user must become an administrator first.
blockers.team_owner: You are the only owner of the team {{name}}, which still has members or projects. Transfer ownership first.

danger.dialogDescription: Your sessions and tokens stop working immediately and your account is removed. This cannot be undone.
danger.consequenceTokens: Every API token you created is revoked.
danger.consequenceExport: Export your data first if you want a copy.
danger.typeEmail: Type your email address to confirm
danger.mismatch: That is not your email address.
danger.deleteFailed: Your account could not be deleted.
